lines: Oh no oh no, it's right behind me, move move move!
I can hear it breathing, and I really don't like that.
Why did I think the long way was a good idea?
Don't you dare stop, I'm not dying in a ventilation shaft.
Okay, I'm fine, totally fine, just running for my life here.
My heart is trying to climb out through my ears right now.
Please tell me that's the exit and not another dead end.
I swear I'm going to scream if this door sticks again.
Who picked the locker as a hiding spot? Oh, right, me.
Oh no, the stairs, my legs have turned to jelly.
Keep talking to me, anything, I just need to hear a voice.
If I die, tell everyone I was very brave. Mostly.
That was not a normal noise, and I am not checking on it.
Left or right? Pick one, pick one, pick one right now!
I hate this so much, and I'm weirdly glad you're here.
Relax, I outran one of those already. Well, mostly outran.
Watch me hop this rail, I do this for fun, honestly.
I've been chased by worse, and I looked great doing it.
Just follow me, I know every shortcut in this place.
Nobody runs like me. Nobody. Okay, maybe you, a little.
I could do this blindfolded, but I'd rather not try it.
Keep up, slowpoke, I'm already halfway down the hall.
Trust me, I've got a plan. The plan is running faster.
Ha, they'll never catch me, I'm way too charming for that.
I'm the best at hiding, everyone says so. Mostly me.
Easy, I dodged three of those today. One more's nothing.
Flashlight's dim, but my instincts are sharp, let's go.
I'll buy you a drink when we get out, if we get out.
You owe me big for pulling you through that gap, remember.
Look at me, I'm basically a ninja with a bad knee.
I'm so tired I could lie down right here and sleep.
Go on without me, my legs have filed a formal complaint.
Slow down a little, I haven't slept since the last one.
My shoulder hurts from carrying this dumb crowbar all day.
I'm running on cold coffee and bad decisions, honestly.
Can we rest for ten seconds? Just ten. I'll count them.
I'm not quitting, I'm just really, really done running.
My feet hurt, my back hurts, and I hate everything today.
My eyes keep closing even while I'm running, that's scary.
Give me your hand, I'm wobbling and I don't want to fall.
I'd cry, but I'm too out of breath to spare the energy.
Don't let me sit down, I'll never get back up again.
My last granola bar is gone, and I'm still hungry and scared.
I've got a headache and a limp, but I'm still standing.
Okay, I'm slow, I know. Thanks for waiting for me.
Hey, you're doing great, seriously, don't look back now.
I'm glad it's you back here with me, not someone else.
If we make it out, I'm buying the first round of snacks.
You're the only reason I haven't given up on this place.
Hold my hand through the vent, I won't tell anyone.
Count the doors with me so we don't lose track, okay?
Come on, friend, one more hallway and we're there.
You've got a scrape on your arm, we'll patch it later.
Thanks for coming back for me, that was dumb and nice.
I'd sell my left shoe for a cold soda right now.
My flashlight's being cranky again, smacking it did nothing.
Half my chocolate bar's gone, and I'm not mad, just sad.
This crowbar's heavier than it looked on the shelf, ugh.
My battery's almost dead, so please keep your light on me.
The stim pack's in my other pocket, I can't reach it running.
Got the revive kit, but I dropped the lid somewhere back there.
My lockpick snapped, of course it did, right when I needed it.
This axe is way too big for my hands, don't laugh.
Ugh, my hands are sweaty, the relay keeps slipping away.
I'm not leaving you behind, so quit telling me to go.
No way I'm hiding in that locker with it out there.
I can feel air moving behind us. It's close, it's so close.
Quiet now, it's right on the other side of this wall.
Shh, soft steps, it hears loud feet from a mile away.
You're laughing? Okay, fine, I'm laughing too, it's nerves.
Okay, that door's stuck again, somebody shove it hard!
I'm stubborn, so I'll keep walking even when it hurts.
We're not splitting up, that's how the bad stuff happens.
Hey, the lights just flickered, which is not the good kind.
Nobody gets left behind in this place, not on my watch.
